newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain Bosworth starts four telecoms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain Bosworth starts four telecoms.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it had initiated coverage on four companies providing personal communications services to secondary markets.
--It started coverage of Commnet Cellular Inc, 360 Communications Co and United States Cellular Corp with buy ratings, and Palmer Wireless Inc with a hold rating.

--Dain Bosworth analyst Glenn Powers said this group of stocks has been very weak over the past two years in anticipation of competition brought on by the Federal Communications Commission's auction of new, higher-frequency spectrum for wireless telephones.
"We believe that the impact of this new competition is vastly overblown, especially for our group of secondary market providers," the reserach firm said in a release.
--Commnet shares traded up 1-3/8 at 28-1/2, 360 Communications rose 1/4 at 23-1/2, U.S. Cellular traded off 1/4 at 28-1/2, and Palmer was off 1/8 at 15-3/8.
